title_as_printed: Visit to the Kibalan Village of Sano Bay, North-East Coast of Formosa. Including a Vocabulary of the Dialect
author: C. Collingwood
journal: Transactions of the Ethnological Society of London
heading_as_printed: Vocabulary of words used by the native inhabitants of Sau-o Bay, East Coast of Formosa.
place: Sau-o Bay (Su'ao), north-east coast of Formosa
about: Words collected by C. Collingwood from the Kibalan (Kavalan) inhabitants of a village at Sau-o Bay on the north-east coast of Formosa during his visit of 13 June 1866, printed as an appendix to his paper.
